title: Scalable Data Fusion with Selection Correction: An Application to Customer Base Analysis
eligible_reason: Methodological paper: aggregate-disaggregate data fusion (MPL estimator) with selection correction for customer base analysis, evaluated by simulation and applied to Spotify subscriber data. No binary staggered treatment and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: Scripts: 'predictive simulation code.r', 'parameter recovery simulation code.r', 'SPOT sample code.R', 'simulate panel data.r', all using the authors' MPL R package. The only regressions in the inventory are lm() AR(1) checks of residuals.
data_files_note: Public Spotify aggregates shipped; the Second Measure member-level panel (NDA) is replaced by a synthetic panel simulated from the estimated model (~50% of the original size).
data_provenance_note: Member-level panel simulated from the estimated model parameters (README).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
